title: Witchfinder (SID)
message:
Hexwarren's C64 music: the in-Warren loop, the cleared and fallen stings, silence and the holder's music,
written with the sid-music skill. Voice 1 bass + drums, voice 2 lead, voice 3 bells / echo / pad / harmony / stabs
(the sound effects borrow it). Sections: cleared, fallen, silence, boss; order 0 is the loop.
